- Builders: Arista Homes, Deco Homes, Opus Homes
- Location: Weston Road & Teston Road, Woodbridge, Vaughan, ON
- Townhome collection: Expected based on comparable builder projects, not yet confirmed
- Comparable product: The Castle Mile (same builders) — 1,583–4,050 sq ft freehold towns/detached

A: Not officially confirmed. Based on the same builder trio's other communities (SouthCal, The

Q: How much do Bridgelands townhomes cost?
A: Not yet announced. Comparable product from the same builders at The Castle Mile spans
